show.description: Fiercely independent Priya and arrogant businessman Kabir Malhotra enter into a marriage of convenience bound by fate, not love. But as their hearts clash and hidden emotions rise, destiny plays its own game. In a world of contract vows, secret pasts, and family pressures, will their accidental marriage turn into a forever bond? Watch Now!
